name: Photography Club
description: Capture moments, tell stories and explore the world through your lens. A strong fit for students interested in photography and creative visual work.
about: The Photography Club is a community of visual storytellers. Whether you are a beginner with a smartphone or an expert with a DSLR, join us to learn framing, lighting, and editing techniques.

name: Coding & Robotics
description: A strong fit for students interested in coding, technology, robotics, artificial intelligence and technical projects.
about: Dive into the world of tech with the Coding & Robotics club. We host hackathons, build hardware prototypes, and explore the cutting edge of AI and software development.

name: Cultural Club
description: Explore cultural activities, performances, music, dance and celebrations while connecting with other students.
about: The Cultural Club is the heartbeat of campus life. We celebrate diversity through music, dance, theater, and grand festivals. Join us to showcase your talent, learn about different traditions, and make memories that last a lifetime.

name: Literary Club
description: A space for students interested in reading, writing, poetry, storytelling, literature and discussions.
about: Whether you are a voracious reader, a budding poet, or a passionate debater, the Literary Club is your haven. We host open mics, book club discussions, and inter-college debate tournaments to hone your communication and creative skills.

name: Fitness Club
description: A good fit for students interested in fitness, physical activities, sports, yoga and staying active.
about: We believe in a healthy mind and a healthy body. The Fitness Club organizes group workouts, yoga retreats, and marathon training. Whether you're a seasoned athlete or just starting your fitness journey, there is a place for you here.

name: Cooking Club
description: Explore cooking, recipes, food and culinary creativity while participating in hands-on activities.
about: From mastering the basics of baking to exploring international cuisines, the Cooking Club brings food lovers together. We host bake sales, cooking competitions, and masterclasses to help you unleash your inner chef.

name: Gardening Club
description: A good fit for students interested in plants, gardening, nature, environmental activities and sustainability.
about: Join us in making our campus greener. The Gardening Club is dedicated to sustainability, urban farming, and botanical care. Learn how to grow your own food, care for houseplants, and participate in campus beautification drives.

name: Music & Acoustics Club
description: A community for musicians, vocalists, and audio enthusiasts to jam, perform, and learn.
about: Whether you're a classically trained pianist or a shower singer, the Music Club provides a stage for everyone. We host weekly jam sessions, vocal training workshops, and campus-wide concerts.

name: Art & Design Club
description: Express yourself through digital and physical mediums in our collaborative art studio.
about: The Art & Design club is a sanctuary for creators. We explore everything from traditional canvas painting and sketching to modern UI/UX design and digital illustration.

name: Astronomy & Space Club
description: Explore the cosmos, learn about astrophysics, and participate in night-sky observation events.
about: Look up! The Astronomy Club brings space enthusiasts together to observe celestial events, discuss astrophysics, and learn astrophotography. We organize regular telescope viewings and planetarium visits.

name: Film & Cinema Club
description: Watch, discuss, and create films with fellow cinema enthusiasts and aspiring filmmakers.
about: The Film & Cinema Club is for anyone who loves the magic of movies. We host weekly screenings, breakdown cinematography techniques, and produce our own short films. Whether you want to direct, act, or just watch, grab some popcorn and join us.

name: Entrepreneurship Club
description: Develop your business acumen, pitch startup ideas, and network with driven student entrepreneurs.
about: Got a great idea? The Entrepreneurship Club helps turn concepts into reality. We connect students with mentors, host pitch competitions, and break down the basics of business strategy, marketing, and venture funding.
